description: Capabilities for the flowpill voice overlay window. `default.json` is scoped to windows: ["main"], so without this file every plugin call from flowpill.html is denied at the IPC boundary. Kept deliberately narrow: no shell, no global-shortcut, no opener. The app's own #[tauri::command]s (flowpill_show, flowpill_hide, ...) need no permission entry; only core and plugin commands do.
